verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Pipedream Connect provides built-in managed user auth, so developers 'don't need to build any authorization flows or deal with token storage and refresh'. They also state that user credentials are encrypted at rest and requests are proxied through Pipedream's servers, with credentials attached server-side and never exposed to models. Users can revoke connected accounts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed documentation of the OAuth flow and token-refresh mechanics beyond brief marketing-level statements.
